issues.where: the bolt behind the peak, frames 7234 to 7237
issues.what: the strike lights nothing: the peak, the snow and the cloud keep the same exposure while the bolt fades out over three frames, so the event does not land
issues.fix: flash the whole ridge and cloud base for one or two frames on the strike, with the snow catching the light, then decay

issues.where: the distant bolt and the sky above the creature, frames 7579 to 7590
issues.what: the strike lights neither the creature nor the mountain, and a small purple blob stays hanging in the sky where the bolt was for ten frames after it is gone
issues.fix: remove the leftover sprite and let the flash light the ice, the fur and the haze for an instant

issues.where: the ribbon cloud filling the sky
issues.what: the cloud is drawn as thin, even, glossy ribbons that all drift sideways at one rate, like a texture scrolling across the frame rather than vapour at its own height
issues.fix: build the cloud as volume with layered speeds, breaking and thinning edges, and parallax between the near and far banks

issues.where: end of the pan, frames 7454 to 7498
issues.what: the camera pans off the cliff and stops on empty ribbon sky and a flat horizon, a weak final picture with no subject
issues.fix: end the move on a framed subject, such as the cliff edge against the sea, or cut before the frame empties

issues.where: the peak and cloud sea, frames 7044 to 7337
issues.what: after the opening flash the shot hardly changes for about five seconds: the peak and the cloud sea read as a held still picture, the push in is barely there, and the near and far planes do not separate
issues.fix: give the cloud sea a slow visible roll and flow around the rock, add blowing snow off the ridge, and travel the camera so the foreground passes the far spires

issues.where: the furry creature on the ice, frames 7499 to 7659
issues.what: the push in ends on a creature that never moves, with no breath, fur or wind, and the frame crops it off on the right, so it reads as a placed model and a weak final picture
issues.fix: add breathing, wind in the fur, a slight head or limb shift, and end the push on a composed frame of the whole creature

issues.what: a long dead hold: rock, sea and cloud are near identical across about three seconds, and the glowing horizontal threads in the sky sit still like painted wires
issues.fix: keep the sea breaking, the rain and fume moving, and let the sky discharge crawl and flicker as it travels

issues.where: the lightning in the cave mouth, frames 8091 and 8094
issues.what: the bolts outside light none of the cave interior: the ice floor, snow and the animals keep the same light
issues.fix: spill a cool flash through the mouth onto the floor, the wet ice and the rims of the animals

issues.where: the fur of the lying animals at the left, frames 8094 to 8101
issues.what: the fur outline and strand shapes change from frame to frame on animals lying still, reading as boiling fur
issues.fix: stabilise the fur groom and sampling across frames; use temporal filtering on the hair

issues.where: the end of the shot, frames 8187 to 8304
issues.what: the camera settles on the rear of one animal standing almost still in the centre for about two seconds, a weak, static final picture; the lying animals have no breath or shift
issues.fix: keep the animal walking out toward the light, or add small turns and a head lift, and give the resting herd breathing and staggered movement

issues.what: the even ripple pattern on the walls looks like tiled noise and may crawl as the camera moves
issues.fix: break up the repeat with larger-scale variation and check it for shimmer at speed
